name: JC-PINN: user Equation 1 backbone with neural correction
model: sigma = sigma_JC(theta) * exp(delta), delta = 5-16-16-1 tanh correction network

variable_mapping.eps: E11, the monotonic axial strain coordinate (user-confirmed 7 Nov 2026)
variable_mapping.rate: matrix strain_rate in 1/s; ln term uses rate/rate0 (user-confirmed strain-rate ratio)
variable_mapping.Tstar: (T - T_ref)/(T_melt - T_ref) with matrix temperature in degrees C; clipped at 0 below T_ref
variable_mapping.G: matrix shear_modulus in MPa (G0 given in MPa by the user)
variable_mapping.phi: 1 - density/rho0 per case (user-confirmed 7 Nov 2026); 1 - phi = density/rho0
variable_mapping.B: reparametrised as B = A*beta/eps_ref^n with 0 <= beta <= 0.99 so A - B*eps^n > 0 for eps <= eps_ref

ensemble: sigma = exp(mean_k[ln sigma_JC(theta_k) + delta_k(z)]); z = (x - x_mean)/x_scale; delta_k = w3.tanh(W2.tanh(W1.z + b1) + b2) + b3

validity.note: Data cover 30-200 C; 200-300 C follows Equation 1 through the physics term only and is unvalidated.
